materials.item: Readings posted as PDF files on eLC
Internet reading assignments listed in the syllabus

FYOS 1001.attendance: Punctual attendance and class participation are expected; the class meets seven times for two-hour periods, and the course is not for students who cannot attend regularly or will not join discussion.
FYOS 1001.lateWork: Deadlines are mandatory: readings done before class, blog entries posted in a timely manner, event reflections and the final report turned in on time. No penalty figures are given.
other: Using AI or word-mixing software to write assignments or disguise plagiarism is unauthorized assistance and is reported to the Office of Academic Honesty.
Students must attend three university community events and report on them by the end of the semester.

FYOS 1001.attendance: Required and taken at every meeting; students must arrive having done the assigned readings and be ready to discuss them.
other: Technology-free class: computers, phones and other devices must be off and put away during class.
